# DeviantArt
> DeviantArt is a global online art community where artists share work, build audiences, and sell creations.

DeviantArt combines galleries, social features, commissions, subscriptions, prints, and AI-assisted creation tools for digital and traditional artists. The platform supports discovery across millions of artworks, artist profiles, groups, journals, and community events.

## Core Platform
- [Home](https://www.deviantart.com/): Main entry point for browsing artwork, artists, collections, and community activity.
- [Join](https://www.deviantart.com/join): Account registration page for creating a DeviantArt profile.
- [Log In](https://www.deviantart.com/users/login): Sign-in page for existing DeviantArt members.
- [Shop](https://www.deviantart.com/shop): Marketplace for buying artwork, adopts, commissions, and digital products.
- [Daily Challenges](https://www.deviantart.com/dailychallenges): Community art prompts and challenge hub for regular participation.
- [DreamUp](https://www.deviantart.com/dreamup): AI image generation tool integrated with the DeviantArt platform.

## Membership & Monetization
- [Core Membership](https://www.deviantart.com/core-membership/buy): Premium subscription with enhanced profile, publishing, and storage features.
- [Subscriptions](https://www.deviantart.com/subscriptions): Creator subscription feature for recurring supporter memberships.
- [Commissions](https://www.deviantart.com/commission): Commission marketplace for artists offering custom work.
- [Prints](https://www.deviantart.com/prints): Print-on-demand storefront for purchasing physical art products.
- [Shop Policies](https://www.deviantart.com/shop/policies): Policy information for transactions, orders, and marketplace usage.

## Help Center
- [Help Center Home](https://www.deviantartsupport.com/): Central support portal for account, publishing, and policy questions.
- [Submit a Request](https://www.deviantsupport.com/en/article/submit-a-request): Contact support for account, billing, or technical issues.
- [Core Membership Help](https://www.deviantsupport.com/en/article/core-membership-faq): FAQ covering Core plans, billing, and included features.
- [Commissions FAQ](https://www.deviantsupport.com/en/article/commissions-faq): Guidance for using DeviantArt commissions as a buyer or seller.
- [Subscriptions FAQ](https://www.deviantsupport.com/en/article/subscriptions-faq): Overview of creator subscriptions, setup, and supporter access.
- [DreamUp FAQ](https://www.deviantsupport.com/en/article/dreamup-faq): Support article explaining DreamUp usage, limits, and policies.

## Policies & Safety
- [Terms of Service](https://www.deviantart.com/about/policy/service): Legal terms governing use of DeviantArt services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.deviantart.com/about/policy/privacy): Privacy practices for data collection, use, and account information.
- [Etiquette Policy](https://www.deviantart.com/about/policy/etiquette): Community behavior standards for respectful participation and interaction.
- [Submission Policy](https://www.deviantart.com/about/policy/submission): Rules for uploading artwork and other submitted content.
- [Copyright Policy](https://www.deviantart.com/about/policy/copyright): Copyright and infringement procedures for creators and rights holders.
- [Mature Content Policy](https://www.deviantart.com/about/policy/mature-content): Standards and restrictions for mature or sensitive artwork.
- [AI Art Policy](https://www.deviantart.com/about/policy/ai): Policy information related to AI-generated content and labeling.

## Community Features
- [Groups](https://www.deviantart.com/groups/): Community groups for shared interests, curation, and themed submissions.
- [Forums](https://forum.deviantart.com/): Discussion boards for community conversation and peer interaction.
- [Journals](https://www.deviantart.com/journals/): Long-form creator posts, updates, and community writing.
- [Status Updates](https://www.deviantart.com/status-update): Short-form posting feature for quick creator updates.
- [Polls](https://www.deviantart.com/polls/): Community polling feature for audience engagement and feedback.
- [Notes](https://www.deviantart.com/notes/): Private messaging system for member-to-member communication.

## Discovery & Browsing
- [Browse](https://www.deviantart.com/browse/all): Artwork discovery page across all categories and media.
- [Popular 24 Hours](https://www.deviantart.com/browse/all/popular-24-hours): Trending artwork based on recent community engagement.
- [Newest](https://www.deviantart.com/browse/all/newest): Chronological feed of newly submitted artwork.
- [Topics](https://www.deviantart.com/topic/): Topic-based discovery across styles, fandoms, and subjects.
- [Search](https://www.deviantart.com/search): Search interface for artwork, artists, groups, and journals.
- [Daily Deviations](https://www.deviantart.com/daily-deviations): Editorially featured artworks highlighted by the community team.

## Artists & Publishing
- [Submit](https://www.deviantart.com/submit/deviation): Upload page for publishing new artwork to DeviantArt.
- [Sta.sh](https://sta.sh/): Creator storage and draft workspace for managing unpublished files.
- [Watch Feed](https://www.deviantart.com/watch/deviations): Personalized feed of artwork from watched creators.
- [Notifications](https://www.deviantart.com/notifications): Activity center for comments, favorites, watches, and mentions.
- [Profile Directory](https://www.deviantart.com/tag/artists): Discovery entry point for finding artists by tag and interest.

## About DeviantArt
- [About](https://www.deviantart.com/about): Overview of DeviantArt, its mission, and platform features.
- [About Team](https://www.deviantart.com/about/team): Information about the people behind DeviantArt.
- [Careers](https://www.deviantart.com/about/jobs): Employment opportunities and company hiring information.
- [Press](https://www.deviantart.com/about/press): Press resources and company background information.
- [Contact](https://www.deviantart.com/about/contact): Contact page for business and general inquiries.
